rules.rule: Grounds and panels are Lime Wash or Verranza Blue and nothing else.
On Verranza Blue, all type is Lime Wash.
On Lime Wash, the house name, display lines and the booking-button label are Verranza Blue.
On Lime Wash, body text, rates and captions are Ink Charcoal.
The three accents are for hairline rules, dividers and small labels only.
Verranza Blue and Lime Wash are mandatory colours.
Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, with no tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode.
No scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph.
No gold, bronze, copper, silver or other metallic effect on any type, panel, rule, button or icon.
No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons or icons.
Photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never recoloured toward the palette.
The monogram is Blue on Lime Wash, or its ink is recoloured Lime Wash on a Blue panel.
The supplied monogram keeps its silhouette and open spaces (the V and C, oval rule and anchor).
Supplied identity artwork is placed at 100% layer opacity.
No fake evening glow added to a photograph.
No crushed blacks in a photograph.
The three accents together cover no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
No stone turned into a computer's idea of stone: stone and limewash keep their photographed texture.
The Casa Scogliera pool in scogliera_pool.jpg stays pale turquoise and is not pushed toward deep blue.
